title: Author a coherent 3-5 plan unit (one subject/grade)
context: The pilot plan (task-008) proves the pipeline works for one plan. M1 requires a coherent unit: 3-5 lesson plans in the same subject and grade band, building on each other with shared objectives, to demonstrate that the project can produce a usable curriculum unit — not just isolated lessons. A coherent unit is more valuable to teachers (who teach sequences, not single lessons) and more adoptable by repositories (which prefer curated units). This task requires all M1 tooling (CASE/LRMI metadata emitter) to be in place so every plan in the unit has machine-readable metadata.
objective: Author 3-5 lesson plans forming a coherent, sequenced unit on a single subject/grade band, each passing both gates with committed artifacts and emitting valid CASE/LRMI metadata.
acceptanceCriteria: 3-5 lesson plans are authored covering the same subject and grade band, with shared or building objectives that form a coherent instructional sequence.
Every plan passes the license gate (teacher-lesson-plans-license-003): all sources have committed PASS artifacts, snapshots, and complete attribution blocks.

Every plan passes the pedagogy/standards review gate (teacher-lesson-plans-reviewer-002): objectives sound, alignment correct, procedure teachable in stated time, answer keys correct, UDL/differentiation present.
CASE/LRMI metadata is emitted and validates successfully for every plan in the unit (teacher-lesson-plans-casemeta-011).
Plans form a coherent sequence: learning objectives build across the unit, and the sequence is documented in a unit overview or README.
At least 1 plan in the unit is taught by a real teacher with structured content feedback recorded (no student PII) in the outcome ledger.
Commits are DCO signed-off; no secrets or PII in committed files.
resources: teacher-lesson-plans-casemeta-011 — CASE/LRMI emitter (required before this task)
teacher-lesson-plans-template-001 — canonical lesson-plan schema and template
OER sources: OpenStax, CK-12, OER Commons, Curriki, Siyavula
output: 3-5 committed lesson plans forming a coherent unit, each with committed gate artifacts (license + pedagogy), emitted CASE/LRMI metadata, and at least 1 with adoption evidence (teaching feedback) in the outcome ledger.
